T483-R1401.issue: Restore original read location; retain failed-conversion guard
T483-R1401.evidence: Original WOW16SetDdeHandleFlag calls SetDdeHandleFlag; its selected get_arena_pointer32 path reads the arena table and sets/clears GAH_WOWDDEFREEHANDLE. It does not allocate, relocate, or invoke application code. The source METAFILEPICT is already GlobalLock16-locked. This converter is called from the guest-origin message thunk before native dispatch; its current GETMISCPTR is a direct mapped pointer, not a callback-epoch temporary buffer. This bounded chain does not justify the earlier read relocation; it does not establish arbitrary callback stability. The remaining !fFailed condition prevents creating a child metafile after its parent native pict was freed on registration failure.

T483-R1405.evidence: CallBack16 can return FALSE before guest entry when task runtime admission fails (wow_user_native_extension.c and callback_enter in wow_user_task_lifecycle.c). Original W32MarkDDEHandle returns VOID, so DDEAddhandle reports success although GAH_WOWDDEFREEHANDLE was not set. Original free notifications cannot retire that unmarked alias. Preserve callback BOOL handling and remove only the added explanatory comment; do not interpret the guest AX0 payload as failure.

T483-R1406.evidence: Original flat HDDE list does not own the DDEDATA subobject graph. A failed outer publication must retire only objects acquired by this conversion. Retain local pair recording and reverse rollback. Every production caller initializes Count once; ADVISE/EXECUTE add one pair, DIB adds child plus packet, METAFILEPICT adds pict plus metafile plus packet, MSDRAW adds metafile plus packet. No caller can add a fourth pair. Delete the unused overflow branch and trivial DDEBeginConversion wrapper; eight callers initialize Count at the identical point. Remove standalone explanatory comments; do not move the algorithm to a shim.

T483-R1407.issue: DDE deletion after callback execution handoff
T483-R1407.evidence: W32DDEFreeGlobalMem32 is installed with RegisterWowBaseHandlers and also reached by exported WOWFreeMetafile. It finds the pair before W32UnMarkDDEHandle and GlobalUnlockFree16, then deletes it. These CallBack16 entries acquire guest execution; callback_enter can park a native owner and DirectedYield to the receiving task. A second task can retire the same shared alias while the native caller waits for guest execution. Original DDEDeletehandle dereferences the now-empty list. Retain the one-line empty-list return, remove its comment. This is a source-eligible scheduling counterexample, not a reproduced guest race; the test callback double demonstrates the list result but cannot prove real timing.

T483-R1408.evidence: Same R1405 failure chain: the original VOID return loses CallBack16 rejection. BOOL communicates whether the original kernel marking routine executed; the guest return payload is independent.

T483-R1409.issue: Return callback result instead of ignoring it
T483-R1409.evidence: Same R1405/R1408 failure chain. Returning CallBack16 BOOL preserves callback admission failure without a second error channel or new callback. Original SetDdeHandleFlag normally returns AX0, which must not be mistaken for failure.

T483-R1410.issue: Distinguish native COPYDATA headers from payload aliases
T483-R1410.evidence: The original list contains both header and payload nodes. A payload may itself hold a COPYDATASTRUCT that is sent in a nested message. Without COPYDATA_HEADER filtering, CopyDataFindData16 returns the payload alias as a header although no independently converted header/embedded data pointer exists. The existing exact-body lifetime fixture explicitly covers nested embedded headers in both directions. Keep the flag predicate, remove its inline comment.

T483-R1411.issue: Distinguish guest COPYDATA headers from payload aliases
T483-R1411.evidence: Same R1410 object-role collision in CopyDataFindData32: a guest payload address becomes a nested message header. Existing exact-body fixture tests distinct converted headers and matched cleanup. Keep the original-list flag filter; remove inline comment.
